test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A cube of side 49 cm is painted purple on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 7 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes having only one face printed.
solution:
Here cube of n × n formulae is:

 
• Cube of no side painted = (n - 2)³
 
• Cube of one side painted = 6 × (n - 2)²
 
• Cube of two side painted = 12 × (n - 2)
 
• Cube of three sides painted = Always 8 

A cube of side 49 cm is painted purple on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides of 7 cm each.

⇒ n = 7
